content.value_statement: Influencer programs often begin without a clear audience or community model. This skill creates structured profiles, cultural guidance, and selection criteria.
actual_capabilities: Builds demographic and psychographic profiles with confidence labels.
Maps purchase behavior, media habits, and platform priorities.
Creates named audience personas and influencer selection criteria.
Decodes niche language, norms, taboos, and credibility signals.
Organizes community voices into leader, rising, and micro tiers.
Produces a 25-point brand fit score and phased entry strategy.
limitations: It does not find, contact, or contract specific creators.
It does not calculate downstream creator, content, or return scores.
Findings remain hypotheses when first-party or current platform data is unavailable.
Live metrics require optional external data sources supplied by the user.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Influencer Program
use_cases.description: Define priority audiences, platforms, content preferences, and creator requirements before discovery begins.

use_cases.title: Evaluate a Niche Community
use_cases.description: Decode community culture, assess brand fit, and identify entry risks before partnership outreach.

use_cases.title: Strengthen a Creative Brief
use_cases.description: Convert customer evidence into personas, media habits, content preferences, and practical creator guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Audience Map
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the target audience for [brand or product] in [market]. Use audience mode and label every inferred attribute by confidence.
prompt_templates.scenario: Start with a brand, product, market, and campaign objective.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Evidence-Based Persona
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this customer data to build audience profiles, platform priorities, content preferences, and one named persona: [data]. Separate facts from assumptions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Turn surveys, sales insights, or social analytics into a planning profile.

prompt_templates.title: Research a Niche Community
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [community] for [brand]. Map subgroups, language, norms, taboos, key voice tiers, content patterns, brand fit, and entry risks.
prompt_templates.scenario: Assess a community before creator outreach or market entry.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose and Rebuild Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this campaign evidence: [results]. Identify audience assumptions that failed, rebuild the map, and produce revised creator criteria with confidence labels.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use campaign results to improve targeting and handoff decisions.

output_examples.input: Analyze a premium skincare audience in the United Kingdom.
output_examples.output: Audience mode selected. The report profiles primary and secondary buyers, ranks platforms, defines content preferences, and creates creator selection criteria.

output_examples.input: Research BookTok for an independent publisher.
output_examples.output: Niche mode selected. The dossier maps community language, voice tiers, content patterns, cultural risks, brand fit, and a phased entry strategy.

output_examples.input: Use these survey findings to create a fitness app persona.
output_examples.output: The result separates survey facts from inferred traits, maps media habits, creates a named persona, and links insights to creator requirements.

best_practices: Provide first-party data, geography, price point, and campaign objectives when available.
Keep confidence labels visible and validate low-confidence assumptions before spending.
Use community members and current platform evidence to verify language, norms, and risks.
anti_patterns: Do not treat inferred demographics or psychographics as verified facts.
Do not use broad personas as substitutes for meaningful audience segments.
Do not select creators before converting findings into explicit criteria and red flags.

faq.question: What is the difference between audience and niche mode?
faq.answer: Audience mode profiles potential customers. Niche mode examines a specific community, its culture, key voices, brand fit, and entry strategy.

faq.question: Can this skill find specific influencers?
faq.answer: No. It prepares selection criteria and voice tiers for a separate influencer discovery workflow.

faq.question: Does it require live data connections?
faq.answer: No. It can use supplied context, but current analytics and first-party data improve confidence.

faq.question: How does the skill handle uncertain information?
faq.answer: It labels inferred attributes with high, medium, or low confidence so users can distinguish evidence from assumptions.

faq.question: What does the brand fit score measure?
faq.answer: It scores community entry fit across values, audience overlap, product relevance, content fit, and price fit.

faq.question: Can results be saved for later sessions?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow asks for permission before writing results or promoting durable facts to memory.
